_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `fem.fem2d` declares 25 mutation kinds over eight id-keyed collections plus one inseparable analysis-settings facet. Semio-NATIVE, no oracle; the structural solvers surveyed and declined are named below. This catalog is NOT the same as `fem3d-1-any`: the 2D artifact's planar noun is a REGION where the 3D artifact's is a SOLID.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: `fem.fem2d` is a semio-NATIVE artifact; `.fem2d.dsl.semio` is read by nothing outside this repository. The structural-analysis ecosystem was surveyed and DECLINED for a reason that applies to the whole family: `frame3dd`, `calculix` and `code_aster` are SOLVERS — they consume a model and produce displacements and stresses — and none of them has an editing vocabulary at all, let alone one that could adjudicate `create-support` or `change-load-case-self-weight`. There is also no neutral structural interchange these 25 kinds map onto: IFC's structural-analysis view (already covered by `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio`'s `🏗️ifc 2x3 ✳️sav` subset) models an analysis model as entity instances with no notion of this artifact's eight id-keyed collections, its loads-inside-a-load-case nesting, or its single inseparable analysis-settings facet. Evidence is the 25 committed specification vectors, one per kind, each a handcrafted `(before, mutation, after, diff, outcome)` quintet over a real timber-frame house model, plus the inverse law as a metamorphic property — which is the sharpest check available here because eleven of the 25 kinds are cascade-bearing: deleting a load case takes its loads with it, deleting a node must not silently take its support, and an inverse that rebuilt the collection by value rather than restoring the prior index space cannot land back on the before-snapshot.
